text_blocks.snippet: Bank of Maharashtra offers a range of interest rates on fixed deposits (FDs) depending on the deposit amount, tenure, and whether the depositor is a senior citizen. For general citizens, interest rates typically range from 2.75% to 6.70% p.a. for tenures from 7 days to 5 years and above, according to Paisabazaar. Senior citizens generally receive an additional 0.50% p.a. on their FDs.
